text:
Alyssa: Pushing a docs PR for the SDK snippets + migration guide. Need 2 reviewers for merge — pinging @Rachel and @Mike. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Rachel: Taking a look now. Quick heads-up — we should enforce the style guide's 'second-person' preference in the migration steps (use 'you' not 'we'). Also watch consistent term: use 'model variant' rather than just 'variant'. :eyes:
Mike: I'll review examples. I noticed one SDK call uses the old `client.generateText()` name — needs to be `client.text.generate()` per the v2 SDK. Small change.
Alyssa: Good catch, Mike. I updated the snippet in the branch. Also added an explicit note about quantization caveats in the migration guide — short paragraph under "Compatibility".
Sam: Thumbs on structure: migration steps look fine but can we add the exact CLI commands for migrating existing checkpoints? e.g. `rwd migrate --from=1.3 --to=2.0 ./models` — feels safer for folks copying.
Rachel: Agree. Also a couple tone nits: replace "you can" with stronger instruction in places ("run"/"use"). And the examples should show both JS and Python for the same flow.
Mike: Found a formatting issue in the JS snippet — missing language tag in fenced block. Should be ```js. Otherwise syntax highlighting fails on previews.
docs-preview-bot: Preview built for PR #482: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-482 — Docs build: succeeded.
Alyssa: Nice, preview link is up. Can reviewers mark :eyes: or leave short notes in the PR so CI links remain attached? We want at least two approvals before merge.
Rachel: Left inline comments on terminology & the two missing language examples. One tiny suggestion: in the migration checklist step 4, clarify that cache invalidation is required after switching quantization.
Mike: Updated JS fenced blocks and swapped `generateText` -> `text.generate` in all snippets. Also added the Python example like Rachel requested. Pushed to the branch.
ci-bot: docs-ci: tests/links: 0 broken links, lint: 1 warning (style/voice), build: passed.
Sam: I added the CLI command example and a sample output block so people know what to expect:
```
$ rwd migrate --from=1.3 --to=2.0 ./models
Migrating model foo... done
```
Alyssa: Thanks everyone. Two approvals needed — Rachel? Mike? If happy, can we aim to merge tomorrow 09:30 PT to avoid interfering with today's release window? I'll hold the merge and monitor oncall if CI flakes.
Rachel: Approved after fixes. :shipit:
Mike: Approved. One tiny nit about a comma I fixed in a follow-up commit. :+1:
Alyssa: Merging tomorrow 09:30 PT. Will post merge notice in #eng-releases and attach the preview URL. If CI re-fails we'll rollback. Thanks y'all!
